title: af/TelemetryConfig@1
description: `af telemetry config RUN --json` (telemetry design §7.4, §10; ADR-0153): one execution's configuration record, assembled from the `config` parts (`af/TelemetryConfig@1` records) its segment holds. `state` is `complete` when every part from 1 to `parts` is retained and the last is marked complete, `incomplete` when one is missing (`missing_parts`), `absent` when the execution recorded none (a level below `spans`). The rows keep the record's fixed order: `af --version --json` (layer `version`); the effective configuration, one row per key with the configuration layer it came from and its file and line as `origin` — a value whose origin is the environment layer is `<env>` and its origin the variable's name; the policy revision, the pipeline's name, digest and nodes, the digests of `.af/af.toml` and `.af/af.lock` and the Task's id, kind and pipeline (layer `policy`); the execution bindings (layer `binding`); the Provider registry entries with grant paths as placeholders (layer `provider`); the harness versions the preflight probed and the Claude Code managed-settings digests (layer `harness`); the host (layer `host`); the names, never the values, of the `AF_*` and `OTEL_*` variables present (layer `variable`). Every value passed the credential rules; a secret-named key withholds its value. `texts` lists, at `content`, the texts the record names (`af.config.text`) by digest and size. Nothing here is evidence.
